memory_update.text: NNI is the highest-priority underfollowed candidate for the student-finance servicing/compliance rail because public disclosures directly tie it to large-scale student-loan servicing, servicing software, Firstmark private-loan servicing and federal regulatory exposure.

MMS is a strong underfollowed BPO/government-services mapping to Federal Student Aid operational chokepoints, including Aidvantage, defaulted-loan administration, contact-center support and back-office processing.
GPN is a speculative-shadow infrastructure candidate through ECSI; include only if later evidence shows Education Solutions/ECSI is financially material or strategically emphasized.

Need later-layer verification of market sizing and public-company materiality: borrower counts, contract values, service-level penalties, complaint data, segment revenue, and whether post-2024 repayment-plan changes create incremental volume or only compliance cost.

This node appears more like a regulated operations-and-software capacity chokepoint than a classic equipment/materials bottleneck; scarce assets are compliant servicing platforms, trained call-center capacity, government contract credentials, secure borrower data workflows and default-resolution infrastructure.

node: Student-finance, loan-servicing, repayment, and compliance rails
summary: Layer 1B expands the universe around student-finance servicing and compliance rails, with emphasis on scarce operational/regulatory infrastructure rather than education providers. The strongest direct public-market mappings found are Nelnet and Maximus, both tied to student-loan servicing or Federal Student Aid operational contracts. Sallie Mae is included as a reference/direct education-finance name because its private student-loan origination, servicing, securitization, and compliance exposure are material. Global Payments is a lower-confidence underfollowed infrastructure hypothesis through ECSI, a wholly owned subsidiary that provides campus-based student-loan servicing, tuition payment plans, refund management, tax-document services, call-center and outsourcing services; exposure materiality to GPN must be verified.
